components.name: moonshine-voice
components.model_license: Moonshine Community License (non-commercial for Vietnamese weights)
modifications: Used as a pinned PyPI dependency behind Hina's SttProvider interface; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
Vietnamese Base weights are fetched through the upstream verified manifest and remain non-commercial until separately cleared.

components.name: faster-whisper
modifications: Used as a pinned PyPI dependency behind Hina's SttProvider interface; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
Hina supports vi/auto language detection, adds deterministic pre-VAD, bounded admission, no-retention and GPU ResourceLease enforcement.

components.name: f5-tts
modifications: Used as a pinned PyPI dependency behind Hina's TtsProvider interface; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
Hina bypasses TorchCodec audio loading on Windows by decoding the fixed WAV with soundfile before invoking the official inference primitives.
Hina restricts conditioning to one hash-bound owner-authorized synthetic reference, CUDA execution, pre-TTS moderation, bounded admission and no runtime text/audio retention.

components.name: omnivoice
components.model_license: CC-BY-NC (version not stated by upstream model card)
modifications: Used as a pinned PyPI dependency behind Hina's TtsProvider interface; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
Hina uses the official from_pretrained, create_voice_clone_prompt and generate APIs with an exact checkpoint revision, CUDA/FP16 inference, SDPA and optional ASR disabled.

Hina restricts conditioning to one SHA-256-bound transcript-aligned owner-authorized synthetic reference and adds bounded chunking, audio validation, scheduler admission, CUDA memory telemetry, deterministic unload and no runtime audio retention.
The pretrained checkpoint is restricted to local non-commercial owner testing until its CC-BY-NC terms are separately cleared.

components.name: vieneu
modifications: Used as a pinned PyPI dependency behind Hina's TtsProvider interface; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.

Hina instantiates the pinned PyTorch CUDA engine through version-specific internal APIs, with exact-revision model and MOSS codec snapshots; the legacy ONNX path remains explicit CPU-only compatibility.
Hina restricts the integration to one allowlisted owner-authorized voice, audio watermarking, bounded admission, cancellation, pre-TTS moderation and no retention or arbitrary voice cloning.

components.name: onnxruntime
modifications: Pinned as a direct runtime dependency because VieNeu's speaker enrollment imports ONNX Runtime even when PyTorch synthesis runs on CUDA.
The CUDA execution provider is not forced on the current Windows GPU profile; the upstream speaker enrollment remains a one-time CPU compatibility step.

components.name: rapidocr
modifications: Used as a pinned PyPI dependency behind Hina's OcrProvider interface; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
Hina pins RapidOCR 3.9.1 PP-OCRv6 small Torch artifacts by SHA-256, forces all inference stages to CUDA:0, verifies device placement and disables every CPU/remote fallback.

This is a local owner-testing candidate: the corrected uncropped Vietnamese long UI CER is 6.944%, above the promotion threshold, so it remains untrusted, TTL-bound and unavailable for autonomous decisions.

components.name: qdrant-client
modifications: Used as a pinned PyPI dependency behind Hina's DerivedMemoryIndex interface; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
Hina uses persistent local mode with no network listener and treats the vector collection as rebuildable derived state rather than authoritative memory.

components.name: qwen3-vl-8b-thinking
modifications: No upstream source file, prompt corpus or model weight is copied into Git; Hina calls the pinned local Ollama distribution through its HTTP API.

One Thinking checkpoint serves text and explicit image analysis. Simple text and routine image description use same-weight pre-closed-thought paths; complex text/visual questions use bounded hidden thinking.
Hina requests full GPU offload, bounds context/output and deadline, sets keep_alive=0, and admits the model through the shared local resource scheduler.

components.name: electron
modifications: Used as an exact npm development dependency for the local desktop main and preload processes; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
Hina enables Chromium sandboxing and context isolation, disables Node integration and webview, and exposes only six named preload operations.

components.name: vue
modifications: Used as an exact npm renderer dependency; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
The Hina renderer contains only presentation state and calls a repository-owned typed preload facade.

components.name: vite
modifications: Used as an exact npm build dependency; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
The build uses repository-authored local-file paths and emits no remote runtime dependency.

components.name: @vitejs/plugin-vue
modifications: Used as an exact npm build dependency for Vue single-file components; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.

components.name: typescript
modifications: Used as an exact npm build and type-check dependency; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
TypeScript 7 is deliberately excluded because vue-tsc 3.3.8 cannot resolve the compiler subpath after the TypeScript 7 package export change.

components.name: vue-tsc
modifications: Used as an exact npm Vue type-check dependency; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.

components.name: @types/node
modifications: Used as an exact npm type-definition dependency; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.

components.name: ws
modifications: Used as the Electron-main-process RFC-6455 client because the Node built-in WebSocket emitted an empty frame for the real VTube Studio response.
Only the fixed loopback endpoint is accepted; no source file or snippet is copied and optional native bufferutil/utf-8-validate addons are not installed.

components.name: @types/ws
modifications: Development-only TypeScript definitions for the pinned ws client; no runtime code is copied.

components.name: three
modifications: Used as an exact npm renderer dependency behind Hina's VRM stage component; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.

components.name: @pixiv/three-vrm
modifications: Used as an exact npm renderer dependency through VRMLoaderPlugin; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.
Hina loads one fixed, locally bundled and independently licensed VRM asset; runtime URLs and user-selected paths are not accepted.

components.name: @types/three
modifications: Used as an exact npm development type dependency; no upstream source file or snippet was copied.

components.name: liru
modifications: Used only through the pinned CPython 3.13 Windows wheel to receive the fixed VTubeStudioSpout sender; no liru source is copied.
The alpha package is isolated behind an optional loopback worker and is not loaded by the Electron renderer.

components.name: moderngl
modifications: Used as the headless OpenGL texture target for liru's Spout2 receiver; no upstream source is copied.

components.name: Pillow
